changelog: Turn a written customer-onboarding step list into one customer onboard voice clip per labeled cue.

en.description: Turn a written customer-onboarding step list into one customer onboard voice clip per labeled cue. This onboarding-step voice studio records each customer onboarding audio and step list voice from the steps the enablement team already wrote, then delivers 8 to 20 customer onboard voice pack files. Use it for onboarding clip packs that keep one written step on each clip.
en.summary: Turn a written customer-onboarding step list into one customer onboard voice clip per labeled cue.
en.title: Customer Onboard Voice: Step-List-to-Clip Reads
